card.name: Website page furniture and link menus
card.fires_on: Words in web page navigation and footer text, such as "Recently by", "Most Emailed", "closed" in comment notices, and "more" after a trailing ellipsis teaser. It also fires on the space or colon just before a list of links.

modes.label: Menu and list headings
modes.description: Words in link lists like Most Popular, Most Emailed, Recently by, and the gap before a dash-separated item.
modes.example: MORE IN Vermont News - Most Popular -<< Most>> Emailed - MEDIA GALLERY

modes.label: Comment and teaser notices
modes.description: Closing words of stock site notices such as comments being closed, or "more" after a cut-off teaser.
modes.example: Mr_Q | September 10, 2009 11:34 AM | Report abuse The comments to this entry are<< closed>>.

card.plain: It marks the stock menu, link and comment-notice text that surrounds the actual article on a web page.
